translations.web: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
translations.bsb: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
translations.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
translations.asv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, be not troubled: these things must needs come to pass; but the end is not yet.
